description: Renders a barcode: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, ITF-14 or Codabar. Returns a link valid for 24 hours, the dimensions and the image itself.

bgcolor.description: Background colour as six hex digits.

color.description: Bar colour as six hex digits.

content.description: The value to encode. Each symbology has its own alphabet and length, listed under the `type` parameter.

scale.description: Width of the narrowest bar in pixels, 1 to 10.

type.description: `code128` (printable ASCII, up to 80 characters), `code39` (digits, capitals and `- . $ / + %`), `code93`, `ean13` (12 digits, or 13 with the check digit), `ean8` (7 or 8 digits), `upca` (11 or 12 digits), `upce` (6 to 8 digits), `itf14` (13 or 14 digits), `codabar` (a start and stop letter A to D around digits).

name: generate_barcode
title: Generate a barcode
